provenance.asset_description: Two illustrations overlayed over a blurred background, in the bottom left is a wallaby-like alien creature, magically enhanced and conjured, glaring balefully as it’s slowly erased from reality, unspooling one strip at a time in a burst of magic. On the right is a humanoid automaton standing motionless, a strange power is between its hands and an intelligence in its unblinking eyes.
